CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation bound to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinate-set), its organization/presentation (explicit coordinate listing), and a separate status/origin field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition linked to content organization/access is stated.

C.rationale: Report explicitly names represented content items with attributes (color) and coordinate sets.

D.rationale: The report separates content identity (red coordinate set) from provenance/status (origin field) for the same referent.

O.rationale: Content presentation/organization is explicitly given as a spatial/constituent coordinate set for the referent.
